items.obligation: Euclidean Spin(4) is decomposed into two chiral SU(2) factors in the Euclidean-first proposal.

The two factors receive distinct gravitational/spacetime and internal-gauge roles. W01 §3 contrasts earlier cited [3] and [30] proposals gauging SU(2) and Lorentz SL(2,C) inside complexified Spin(4,C) with Woit's Euclidean Spin(4) approach. Its two Euclidean factors are not interchanged: SU(2)_L is an INTERNAL WEAK YANG–MILLS gauge factor, while SU(2)_R is the SPACETIME factor whose chiral spin connection is used in the proposed gravitational sector. Both statements are source attribution and proposed roles, not a qualified interacting unification.

W01 represents Spin(4) by independent left/right SU(2)=Sp(1) actions, with the Euclidean vector action x -> g_L x g_R^{-1}; the two factors are structurally independent in Euclidean signature. The sign-paired representatives are not identical Spin-group elements. In the quaternion presentation SU(2)=Sp(1) is the unit-quaternion group with independent left and right multiplication and the imaginary-time coordinate maps to the identity.

In Euclidean E4 the two spinor spaces transform independently, whereas Minkowski SL(2,C) action g on S_R forces the (g^dagger)^(-1) action on S_L. A twistor spacetime point is a C2 plane S_R inside T=C4, with its point-relative quotient S_L=T/S_R and tangent Hom(S_R,S_L).
